vagabond.description: Started with nothing. You drift from station to station leaving debts behind. No rules, no plan, no future.
vagabond.bonusDesc: Cheap shot in combat (ignores armor) · +15% crit · Fragile but unpredictable

ferrailleur.description: Your ship is falling apart in real time. You repair it with scrap and hope. Mostly scrap.
ferrailleur.bonusDesc: ⚠ 30% chance to lose cargo while traveling · Tough but slow

endette.description: Someone wants their money back. Every. Day. You owe 50cr a day to someone you don't want to meet.

accro.description: You have expensive habits. Non-negotiable. Every trip costs you an extra 100cr for your needs.
accro.bonusDesc: ⚠ -100cr per trip · High max stamina · Erratic attacks

rayane.description: His stats are catastrophic. His only strength: when all seems lost, he always offers to bet it all on a coin flip. It's up to you to judge if the risk is worth it.
rayane.bonusDesc: ⚠ Worst stats in the game · 🪙 Coin flip AVAILABLE (never forced) in combat, while fleeing, refueling, on quest rewards, and once when facing death per run

maudit.description: The universe simply doesn't like you. Positive events have a 50% chance of turning against you.
maudit.bonusDesc: ⚠ Positive events 50% chance to fizzle · Balanced combat

marchand.description: Nothing special. Honest work in a dishonest universe. You buy, you sell, you survive.
marchand.bonusDesc: Neutral class · Bonus on negotiations · Balanced stats

mecanicien.description: You know engines. You're broke as hell. But your ship holds together — roughly.
mecanicien.bonusDesc: Max fuel +4 · Stamina bonus · Good combat endurance

explorateur.description: Seen it all. Failed at it all. But you keep moving forward. Calm places reward you better.
explorateur.bonusDesc: Neutral events more frequent · Sharpened reflexes (+8% crit)

medecin.description: You patch bodies in clandestine clinics. You know death. You delay it.
medecin.bonusDesc: Medicine sells +50% · Quick heal in combat · High max HP · -10% damage taken

contrebandier.description: Good prices, dangerous enemies. You live off schemes. Every deal is a matter of survival.
contrebandier.bonusDesc: -20% on purchases · Guaranteed escape 1×/fight · ⚠ Pirates 2× more frequent

veteran.description: Thirty years of wars for forgotten causes. You're still standing. That's enough.
veteran.bonusDesc: +30% attack · -20% damage taken · Starts with 1 momentum · Accomplished warrior

heritier.description: Old money. Pacifist upbringing. You don't know how to fight but your wallet makes up for it.
heritier.bonusDesc: +300cr every 5 days · ⚠ Can't buy weapons · Weak in combat

hackeur.description: Systems have no secrets from you. Walls are suggestions. Locks, invitations.
hackeur.bonusDesc: Sees destination prices · Hacks enemy equipment · Physically fragile

seigneurDeGuerre.description: Feared everywhere. Welcome nowhere peaceful. Pirates avoid you. So do merchants.
seigneurDeGuerre.bonusDesc: Pirates auto-eliminated · Combat intimidation · +50% attack · ⚠ Peaceful stations refuse you
